_comment: BSE (XBOM) Equity Cash segment. This file states ONLY the special trading sessions verified below (two Muhurat Trading sessions plus one Union Budget 2026 live-trading Sunday) — it is NOT a BSE holiday calendar. `years` is deliberately empty: listing 2024/2025/2026 here would hand this file sole authority for those years (src/markets/calendars.py `_day()`), and every BSE holiday or early close that year NOT also transcribed here would then silently read as a plain open trading day. Every other BSE date, in 2024, 2025, 2026 or any other year, is answered by the calendar provider (exchange_calendars XBOM) exactly as if this file did not exist.
source: BSE Notices 20241019-1 (19 Oct 2024), 20250922-21 (22 Sep 2025) and 20260116-33 (16 Jan 2026); the first two are "Muhurat Trading Session for Equity Segment on account of Diwali Laxmi Pujan", the third is "Equity Trading Session on account of Union Budget 2026"
segment: BSE Equity (cash) segment — Muhurat trading sessions and the Union Budget 2026 special Sunday session only; no other BSE schedule or holiday data

verification.how: all three notices fetched directly from bseindia.com on 2026-10-16 with a plain HTTP GET (urllib, no JS rendering needed — the notice text is in the static HTML); sha256 of the fetched page recorded beside each in provenance
open_items: No other BSE (XBOM) holiday, early-close or special-session date has been verified from a BSE source by this file; none is implied by its presence.

provenance.title: Muhurat Trading Session for Equity Segment on account of Diwali Laxmi Pujan
provenance.covers: Friday 2024-11-01 Muhurat: log-in 17:00-17:30, pre-open order entry 17:45-17:53 / matching 17:53-18:00, continuous trading 18:00-19:00, closing 19:00-19:10, post-closing 19:10-19:20 IST

provenance.title: Muhurat Trading Session for Equity Segment on account of Diwali Laxmi Pujan
provenance.covers: Tuesday 2025-10-21 Muhurat: log-in 12:45-13:15, pre-open order entry 13:30-13:38 / matching 13:38-13:45, continuous trading 13:45-14:45, closing 14:45-14:55, post-closing 14:55-15:05 IST

provenance.title: Equity Trading Session on account of Union Budget 2026
provenance.covers: Sunday 2026-02-01 Union Budget live session: log-in 7:00am-9:00am, pre-open order entry 9:00am-9:08am / matching 9:08am-9:15am, continuous trading 9:15am-3:30pm, closing 3:30pm-3:40pm, post-closing 3:40pm-4:00pm IST; no T+0 settlement session or auction session for settlement default

notes: The BSE closing session (19:00-19:10 in 2024, 14:45-14:55 in 2025, 15:30-15:40 in 2026) is not modelled as a phase here, the same convention data/calendars/XNSE.json uses for NSE's equivalent closing session.

NSE ran Diwali Muhurat at the same clock times on both dates (NSE/CMTR/70319 for 2025-10-21, already in data/calendars/XNSE.json; the NSE 2024 circular is not transcribed here since this file is XBOM-only) — read as the two exchanges coordinating Muhurat timing that year, not inferred for BSE from NSE's file.

The Union Budget 2026 session (Sunday 2026-02-01) is read ONLY from BSE's own notice 20260116-33 above, not inferred from any NSE circular or from BSE's Muhurat precedent; data/calendars/XNSE.json makes no claim about this date, so BSE and NSE are independently verified and may diverge on it.

A public end-of-day feed (e.g. yfinance TCS.BO) showing zero volume for 2025-10-21 is a data-provider gap, not evidence BSE was closed: BSE's own notice above states continuous trading ran 13:45-14:45 that day. This file records the exchange's own schedule, not a particular vendor's capture of it.
limitations: This file answers ONLY 2024-11-01, 2025-10-21 and 2026-02-01 for XBOM. No BSE holiday list, early close, or any other special session — for 2024, 2025, 2026 or any other year — has been verified from a BSE source and none is claimed here.

Other dates are outside this file; they continue to use the existing provider/built-in calendar and remain UNKNOWN when that source lacks verified coverage. In particular, no other Sunday (e.g. the Sundays immediately before or after 2026-02-01) is claimed by this file: each remains whatever the provider/built-in calendar says, since BSE does not ordinarily trade on a Sunday and only this one date has a BSE notice opening it.
